status: Geometry and conditional span sensitivity only. No strength or connection capacity verification completed.

spanSensitivity.assumptions: Simply supported prismatic beam, same uniformly distributed line load w and same E and I. Grid spacing used as a provisional span proxy; actual bearing span remains to be confirmed.

purlinCaveat: Current code places rows at 0.50 m horizontal transverse increments, equivalent to about 0.618 m along the idealized slope. This is not a validated manufacturer or structural spacing. Rendered purlin counts and sections are illustrative.
